versions.content: Ethernet Driver (Eth) The Ethernet Driver manages Ethernet controller MAC hardware, descriptor rings, and DMA packet buffers. function Eth_Transmit [SWS_CP_ETH_00001] Std_ReturnType Eth_Transmit(uint8 CtrlIdx, Eth_BufIdxType BufIdx, Eth_FrameType FrameType, boolean TxConfirmation, uint16 LenByte, const uint8* PhysAddrPtr); Transmits an Ethernet frame via the specified controller hardware buffer and destination MAC address. function Eth_Init [SWS_CP_ETH_00002] void Eth_Init(const Eth_ConfigType* CfgPtr); Initializes the Ethernet MAC controller, DMA rings, and PHY link interface. Ethernet Interface (EthIf) EthIf coordinates multiple Ethernet controllers and transceivers, abstracts VLAN tagging, and routes frames to upper network stacks. function EthIf_Transmit [SWS_CP_ETH_00010] Std_ReturnType EthIf_Transmit(uint8 CtrlIdx, Eth_BufIdxType BufIdx, Eth_FrameType FrameType, boolean TxConfirmation, uint16 LenByte, const uint8* PhysAddrPtr); Upper-layer transmission interface handling VLAN frame encapsulation and priority queuing. Socket Adaptor (SoAd) SoAd connects AUTOSAR PDU-based modules (PduR, DoIP, SOME/IP) to IP/socket-based protocols (TCP, UDP). function SoAd_IfTransmit [SWS_CP_ETH_00020] Std_ReturnType SoAd_IfTransmit(PduIdType TxPduId, const PduInfoType* PduInfoPtr); Converts a PDU transmit request into a socket send operation across a configured TCP or UDP socket connection.
